latest.title: Autorização de Granularidade Fina (FGA) em Escala: Implementando Policy-Based Access Control com Amazon Verified Permissions e Cedar
latest.description: O artigo problematiza o colapso do RBAC em cenários complexos e estrutura a adoção do PBAC utilizando a linguagem matemática Cedar e o Amazon Verified Permissions. Direcionado a arquitetos de segurança e engenheiros seniores, o material orienta a construção de motores de decisão centralizados e a imposição (enforcement) na borda da nuvem através de Lambda Authorizers no Amazon API Gateway, garantindo isolamento total da camada de domínio hexagonal.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
